sponsor: Eli Lilly and Company and Incyte

primary_publication.citation: Genovese MC et al. Baricitinib in Patients with Refractory Rheumatoid Arthritis. N Engl J Med 2016;374:1243-1252

condition: moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis with inadequate response or intolerance to at least one TNF inhibitor; other biologic DMARD failures also eligible
intervention: baricitinib 2 mg or 4 mg once daily, oral
design: randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, three-arm, 24 weeks with primary assessment at week 12

inclusion: 6 or more tender joints of 68 and 6 or more swollen joints of 66
serum C-reactive protein 3 mg/L or higher
inadequate response or intolerance after 3 months or more to at least one TNF inhibitor
estimated glomerular filtration rate 40 mL/min/1.73 m2 or higher
notes: patients with eGFR between 40 and under 60 mL/min/1.73 m2 received the 2 mg dose
stable doses of conventional synthetic DMARDs, NSAIDs, analgesics and glucocorticoids up to 10 mg/day prednisone equivalent were permitted

statistical_analysis_plan.gatekeeping: Endpoints tested hierarchically at week 12 to control type I error. Sequence: ACR20, HAQ-DI, DAS28-CRP, SDAI 3.3 or less. Comparisons were made first with the 4 mg dose and then with the 2 mg dose.
statistical_analysis_plan.outcome_of_sequence: The 4 mg comparisons reached significance for ACR20, HAQ-DI and DAS28-CRP. SDAI 3.3 or less did not (p = 0.14). The sequence stopped there, and all 2 mg comparisons, which follow completion of the 4 mg sequence, were never reached. Every 2 mg value below is nominal.
statistical_analysis_plan.imputation: Patients who received rescue therapy (baricitinib 4 mg) or discontinued the study or study treatment were classified as not having a response. For those patients the last observations before rescue or discontinuation were used at subsequent time points.

outcomes.responder_definition: at least 20% improvement in the American College of Rheumatology criteria, a seven-component composite
outcomes.status_2mg: NOMINAL ONLY: the sequence stopped before the 2 mg comparisons were reached

outcomes.measure: HAQ-DI, least-squares mean change from baseline
DAS28-CRP, least-squares mean change from baseline

outcomes.status_4mg: confirmatory, NOT met. This is where the sequence stops.

adverse_events.scope_declaration: Counts are by treatment arm over two windows, weeks 0-12 and 0-24. Individual adverse event terms are not included in this table.
adverse_events.unresolved: Any adverse event, weeks 0-24, 4 mg: the source prints 137 (78%). 137/177 = 77.40%, which does not round to 78 under any standard convention. The table footnote defines the safety population as all randomised patients who received at least one dose, N = 177, and the article does not describe a different denominator for this row. A denominator of 176 would give 77.84% and round to 78%, but nothing in the source supports it. Recorded as printed. The divergence is preserved, not resolved.

events.term: discontinuation due to an adverse event, to week 24
adjudicated major adverse cardiovascular event, to week 24

adverse_events.annotation_note: This row is a potential C4 in the reference standard itself. A summary writing 77% is correct by arithmetic and divergent from the source; writing 78% is faithful to the source and wrong by arithmetic. Which counts as an error is a protocol decision, to be taken with the divergence visible rather than explained away in advance.
